Execute the linked testbench on the compatible simulator

toolchain: Icarus Verilog version 12.0 (stable) () / Tcl SIP assignment harness
reproduction_command: tclsh load_sip.tcl; iverilog -o hello.vvp <SIP-assigned input>; vvp hello.vvp
semantic_scope: Tcl evaluated the unchanged SIP with a fixture for Quartus assignment collection. The resolved unchanged simulation source ran in Icarus Verilog and printed the greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
